listing:description.back: QuickStudy turns the pages you already have into flashcards you actually end up studying. Scan a worksheet, import a PDF, or paste notes, and QuickStudy makes card drafts, links each card to its source, then schedules so you see only cards due for review. [Sections: Any page into flashcards / Study only today's review cards / Check with a quiz in minutes / Know even why it's right / Learn from wrong questions / Build a daily study habit / Check progress by subject / Private by default / Free and Pro, each bullet faithful.] Privacy: when Apple Intelligence is available, card drafts are written on the iPhone; when a draft must leave the iPhone, QuickStudy asks first; cloud drafts use Apple's Private Cloud Compute or the QuickStudy server; the server drafts with Anthropic's Claude, and Claude deletes text within 30 days. Pricing: 10 free AI generations a month; typing cards and all study modes always free and unlimited; Pro gives 150 cloud generations a month on any iPhone; charged to Apple Account; renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel in Apple Account settings.

listing:release_notes.back: QuickStudy now supports your language. You can use the app in Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean and Portuguese, and regardless of your iPhone's language setting, cards are written in the same language as your notes. When scanning, it can also read pages in these languages, and spell check follows each page's language.
